summary: Initial testing of GruaApp - Tow truck marketplace MVP. All backend API endpoints tested and passing. All frontend E2E tests passing. Core features validated: Health check, Auth flows (registration with OTP, login), Admin dashboard with stats, Admin wallet management, Driver dashboard, Protected routes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Test infrastructure set up with Playwright and pytest. 4 frontend spec files created covering core flows, admin flows, registration flows, and golden path E2E journeys. Backend tests cover auth, admin, and service endpoints. All tests passing. No driver vehicle registration tests with actual wallet recharge due to no existing drivers in DB.
